title: nyblnet/bento
claim: nyblnet/bento — Bento, the office suite that fits in a file
why_good: Bento is a single HTML file that is a full presentation editor and viewer. It includes morphing animations, live collaboration with end-to-end encryption, built-in charts, and AI-editable JSON, all in a ~560 KB file that works offline.
value: Freelance consultants and educators pay for a one-time purchase or a small fee to get a presentation tool that guarantees their decks remain accessible and editable forever, without subscription fees or cloud dependency.
risk: The biggest risk is that Microsoft or Google adds a 'save as single file' feature to their existing products, making Bento's core advantage obsolete.

zh.claim: Bento 是一个适合放在文件里的办公套件，它是一个单 HTML 文件，自带查看器、编辑器和演示器，文件本身就是软件。
zh.hook: 厌倦了 PowerPoint 订阅制和云依赖的顾问和教育工作者，需要一个可以永远拥有、随处打开的文件，即使在 2036 年也能打开。
zh.does: Bento 是一个单 HTML 文件，它是一个完整的演示文稿编辑器和查看器。它包含变形动画、端到端加密的实时协作、内置图表和 AI 可编辑的 JSON，全部在一个约 560 KB 的文件中，且支持离线使用。
zh.why_use: 与 PowerPoint 或 Google Slides 不同，Bento 给你一个自包含且永不过时的文件：无需账户、无需安装、无需云。你可以在任何浏览器中编辑它，它甚至可以在保存时重写自身。它是本地优先的，并且可证明离线，数据是纯 JSON，任何 AI 都可以编辑。
zh.gap: 当前版本是开发者工具：需要从 GitHub 或网站下载文件，虽然易于使用，但围绕它没有为普通用户打磨的产品，而且中国市场没有本地化版本。
zh.counter: 微软和谷歌已经用成熟且功能丰富的产品占据了演示市场。Bento 是一个小众工具，可能被视为一个功能而非公司，如果 PowerPoint 增加“单文件导出”选项，它可能会被杀死。
zh.differentiator: 将 Bento 打包成面向消费者的产品，提供拖拽式模板画廊和一键“制作演示文稿”流程，并提供中文本地化版本，包含适合中国用户的模板和支持。
zh.value: 自由顾问和教育工作者会为一次性购买或小额费用付费，以获得一个保证他们的演示文稿永远可访问和可编辑的工具，无需订阅费或云依赖。
zh.risk: 最大的风险是微软或谷歌在其现有产品中添加“另存为单文件”功能，使 Bento 的核心优势变得过时。
zh.why_good: Bento 是一个单 HTML 文件，它是一个完整的演示文稿编辑器和查看器。它包含变形动画、端到端加密的实时协作、内置图表和 AI 可编辑的 JSON，全部在一个约 560 KB 的文件中，且支持离线使用。

does: Bento is a single HTML file that is a full presentation editor and viewer. It includes morphing animations, live collaboration with end-to-end encryption, built-in charts, and AI-editable JSON, all in a ~560 KB file that works offline.
why_use: Unlike PowerPoint or Google Slides, Bento gives you a file that is self-contained and future-proof: no account, no installer, no cloud. You can edit it in any browser, and it even rewrites itself on save. It's local-first and provably offline, with a plain JSON data block that any AI can edit.
gap: No verified demand; the product is a technical marvel but lacks evidence of real users or pain.
counter: Microsoft and Google already own the presentation market with mature, feature-rich products. Bento is a niche tool that may be seen as a feature, not a company, and could be killed if PowerPoint adds a 'single-file export' option.
differentiator: Package Bento as a consumer-friendly product with a drag-and-drop template gallery and a one-click 'make a deck' flow, and offer a Chinese-localized version with templates and support for Chinese users.
hook: Consultants and educators who are tired of PowerPoint's subscription lock-in and cloud dependency need a deck that they can own forever and open anywhere, even in 2036.
consumer_angle: Could be a simple way for non-technical users to create and share presentations, but no proof of demand.
pick_reason: No first-hand evidence of pain or usage; stars alone are not demand.
